description: This file is a shell script used as a testing suite for Git's diff-tree functionality. It sets up various test cases involving Git trees with duplicate entries, tests for proper diff behavior, renames, and error handling, as well as branch switching and reset scenarios.

methods.name: make_tree_entry
methods.description: Creates a tree entry with specified mode, type, and SHA1, using printf to format the entry and perl to convert the SHA1 into bytes.

methods.name: make_tree
methods.description: Constructs a Git tree object from multiple entries, utilizing make_tree_entry for each entry, then hashes the input to create a tree object.
